title: Select and authorize identity-verification and certified-mail providers
exact_question: Choose counsel/privacy-reviewed identity-verification and postal adapters, confirming minimum-data handling, sandbox behavior, certified/return-receipt semantics, webhook authenticity, retention, and provider terms.
safe_boundary: Use manual attestation or manual PDF/print/export only; never claim verified authority, mailing, delivery, or return receipt without provider or human evidence.
unblock_condition: Provider ADRs, current docs, sandbox evidence, DPA/retention review, and credential lane assignments are recorded.
release_impact: Blocks identity and certified-mail live-fire claims; unrelated local workflow work continues.
